question.problem:
Solve the following system of linear equations by finding the inverse of the coefficient matrix:

$$
\begin{aligned}\{\begin{aligned}2x+3y+z=6 \\ 4x+7y+2z=0 \\ 3x+y+z=1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
We wish to write this system in the form $Ax=b$, where $A$ is a $3\times 3$ matrix and $x$ and $b$ are $3\times 1$ column vectors. We can do this as follows:

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & 3 & 1 \\ 4 & 7 & 2 \\ 3 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}6 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$

Now, the solution to $Ax=b$ is given by $x={A}^{-1}b.$ So, we compute ${A}^{-1}$ as follows:

*Step 1:*

$$
\begin{aligned}det(A) & =|\begin{aligned}2 & 3 & 1 \\ 4 & 7 & 2 \\ 3 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}| \\  & =2|\begin{aligned}7 & 2 \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}|-3|\begin{aligned}4 & 2 \\ 3 & 1\end{aligned}|+1|\begin{aligned}4 & 7 \\ 3 & 1\end{aligned}| \\  & =2(7-2)-3(-2)+1(4-21) \\  & =10+6-17 \\  & =-1.\end{aligned}
$$

*Step 2:*

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}|\begin{aligned}7 & 2 \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}4 & 2 \\ 3 & 1\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}4 & 7 \\ 3 & 1\end{aligned}| \\ |\begin{aligned}3 & 1 \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 3 & 1\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ 3 & 1\end{aligned}| \\ |\begin{aligned}3 & 1 \\ 7 & 2\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 4 & 2\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ 4 & 7\end{aligned}|\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}5 & -2 & -17 \\ 2 & -1 & -7 \\ -1 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

*Step 3:*

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}5 & 2 & -17 \\ -2 & -1 & 7 \\ -1 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}].
$$

*Step 4:*

$$
{C}^{T}=[\begin{aligned}5 & -2 & -1 \\ 2 & -1 & 0 \\ -17 & 7 & 2\end{aligned}].
$$

*Step 5:*

$$
{A}^{-1}=\frac{1}{det(A)}{C}^{T}=-\frac{1}{1}[\begin{aligned}5 & -2 & -1 \\ 2 & -1 & 0 \\ -17 & 7 & 2\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-5 & 2 & 1 \\ -2 & 1 & 0 \\ 17 & -7 & -2\end{aligned}].
$$

Hence

$$
\begin{aligned}x & ={A}^{-1}b \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-5 & 2 & 1 \\ -2 & 1 & 0 \\ 17 & -7 & -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}6 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-29 \\ -12 \\ 100\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Hence the solution is $x=-29,y=-12,z=100.$
